subject: Logic
title: Direct Proof
description: A quick win: understand Direct Proof.

hook.text: The most straightforward strategy: start with what you know and march step by step to the conclusion.

buildup.text: A direct proof assumes the premises are true, applies rules, and derives the conclusion. No tricks.

discovery.text: Prove: if n is even, then n² is even. Let n = 2k. Then n² = 4k² = 2(2k²), which is even. Done.

twist.text: Direct proofs are clean but not always possible. Some conclusions resist a forward march.

climax.text: When a direct path exists, take it. It's the most transparent and convincing proof method.

quiz.question: How does a direct proof work?
options: It assumes the conclusion is false
It derives the conclusion from the premises step by step
